Question: My daughter was born on 19th May 2007 Saturday at 1:50 pm at Srinagar. And I chose a name "Lyza" or "Laiza" . Lyza means (Allah ke liye Waqaf). Now, I want to know more about the name "Lyza" like its background etc. Most people told me that you should enquire about the name. Please help me in a best possible way. I am in a dillema. Please tell me more abt the usage of numerological way while selecting name of baby. Answer ID: 1730 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1307/1167=B) We do not know the meaning of Lyza. You may choose any name from amongst these names: Maimunah, Zainab, Umm Aiman, Umm Habibah, Fauzia, Ghazalah etc. We neither know to select names by numerological ways. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
